record.question: Who among the following is appointed as leader of the Rajya Sabha?
record.explanation: Answer C: Thawarchand Gehlot. Thaawarchand Gehlot was named Leader of the House in the Rajya Sabha after the 2019 election. Reference: https://sansad.in/rs/about/leader-of-the-house. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
